summary_1line: Kunti vows to faithfully serve a demanding Brahmana guest, patiently enduring his harsh tests and satisfying him through unwavering devotion and humility.

image_candidates.scene_text: Princess Kunti stands calmly in the deep of night presenting food to a stern Brahmana who has arrived unexpectedly.
King Kuntibhoja formally presents the young princess Kunti to the visiting Brahmana in a bright palace chamber.
Kunti humbly tends to the ascetic’s seat and bedding beside the sacred fire as he watches her with severe expression.
